## Indicator Analysis — 4H BTC (as of 2024-07-11 12:00, close ≈ 57,378)

| Indicator | Latest Reading | Prior | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|
| **RSI (14)** | 47.8 | 58.5 (2 bars ago) | Neutral, fading lower |
| **MACD** | 101.8 | 205.5 → 149.4 → 101.8 | Positive but rapidly decaying |
| **MACD Hist** | +9.5 | 130.5 → 59.5 → 9.5 | Collapsing toward bearish cross |
| **MACD Signal** | 92.3 | 89.9 | Price momentum barely above signal |
| **ROC (10)** | −1.38% | −1.12% | Negative, rolling over |
| **Stoch %K / %D** | 36.2 / 48.2 | K 58.2 → 50.3 → 36.2 | Bearish, K pierces below D, into lower zone |
| **Williams %R (14)** | −82.7 | −81.8 | Oversold (< −80) |

### Read
- **Trend/momentum:** The July 1 rally peak (63,437) has fully reversed; price is ~9.5% off the high and printing lower lows. RSI slid from ~61 to ~48, ROC negative — bias is **bearish**.
- **Momentum exhaustion:** The MACD histogram has shrunk from +130 to +9.5 over three bars while the MACD line rolls toward its signal. This is a **bearish crossover imminent** — momentum is bleeding out, not re-accelerating.
- **Oversold cluster:** Stochastic (K 36, <D) and Williams %R (−82.7) are in oversold territory. This flags **short-term downside exhaustion** — risk of a technical bounce, but in a downtrend, oversold can extend.

### Actionable takeaway
- **Momentum is bearish-to-neutral; do not chase longs here.** The MACD/signal compression is a warning that the prior up-leg is dead.
- **Watch the MACD for a confirmed bearish cross** below signal (~92 on the MACD line) — that would validate continuation lower toward the 57,000 / prior 54,400 swing.
- **Oversold prints (Stoch/Williams)** argue for tactical caution on fresh shorts at the lows — a mean-reversion **bounce is plausible**, but treat it as counter-trend (quick, small size) unless RSI reclaims 55+ and MACD turns back up.
- **Net:** short-bias on rallies into 58,000–58,800, invalidation on reclaim of 59,500+ with re-expanding MACD histogram. Longs only as scalp-mean-reversion in the oversold zone.

*Note: These are 4H readings — swing timeframe, not tick-level HFT signals. Confirm with lower-timeframe price action and volume before execution.*
